surfaces.name: sno command line, Sno Reach, heartbeat and skills run inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw (Linux, macOS, WSL2)
sno squad full-screen terminal view, status lines and tmux bar
sno.ai hosted account, dashboard and optional Sno-hosted REM / Self Learning engine (closed service)

claims.answer: Command-line product: the sno CLI, Reach and skills run on Linux (x86-64, ARM64), macOS (Intel, Apple silicon) and WSL2 and operate inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. sno squad is a full-screen terminal view; Claude Code and Cursor status lines and a tmux bar show who needs you. A hosted sno.ai dashboard exists for the account (closed). No desktop GUI, native Windows, mobile apps or browser work client.

claims.answer: Sno Station embeds no harness. It installs memory, skills and Reach into five third-party harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw), launches their terminal commands in tmux or ACP seats, and runs mixed-vendor pairs. Model choice belongs to each agent; Self Learning/REM engines have their own model setting.
